# DESIGN: {Project Name}

<!-- Generated by /gm-gdd. The project's visual contract: it stays authoritative
     for every later asset generation and visual evaluation.

     Plain Markdown only. No YAML token blocks, no required screenshots, no
     generated design boards, no component galleries.

     Cross-tag and accumulating. Later tags update only the sections whose
     visual direction actually changed.

     Write only what the GDD, the user, or a readable reference actually
     establishes. Leave anything unknown as `{unspecified}` — never invent a
     rule to fill a heading.

     Target size: roughly 60-100 lines. This is a reusable visual contract,
     not an exhaustive art bible.

     Per dimension: one short principle sentence, then 2-4 observable
     application rules, plus one negative rule only when that failure mode is
     especially likely. Use MUST / MUST NOT only for genuinely non-negotiable
     rules.

     Technical requirements are NOT design rules and must stay out of this
     file: canvas size, alpha, frame counts, atlas regions, metadata, Godot
     resource types, and engine bindings belong to ASSETS.md and the Asset
     Skill contracts. -->
